notes: *which had* divides as rule 18 and rule 43 direct: *had* to the possessive `לְ`, *which* to its suffix, the waw unrepresented.
`מִתַּחַת` fuses as a compound preposition headed on the governing morpheme standing first (rule 23); the following `לְ` is `unrepresented` for want of a written word.
The suffix of `אָרְכָּהּ` is unrendered beside the measure accusative *in length* (rules 22, 33).
